BC_description: The 'spread' method of the Promise class no longer accepts a second argument, which was previously used as an onRejected handler for error handling. This breaks code that passed a second function to 'spread' for handling rejections.
Adaptation_method: Remove the second argument from calls to 'spread'. If the second argument was an onRejected handler for errors, handle errors in a preceding 'catch' block. Example: Before - promise.spread((arg1, arg2) => { /* code */ }, (error) => { /* error handling */ }); After - promise.catch((error) => { /* error handling */ }).spread((arg1, arg2) => { /* code */ });
